title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型系统卡与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计闭源推理模型报告中已披露与未披露的后训练数据、反馈和复现边界
one_line: OpenAI's o3-mini System Card reports broad pretraining-source categories, data filtering, large-scale reasoning RL, deliberative alignment, and safety evaluations, but not reusable records, the RL reward contract, or a reproducible post-training recipe.
OpenAI o3-mini System Card 披露了宽泛的预训练数据类别、过滤、大规模推理强化学习、deliberative alignment 与安全评测，但没有公开可复用记录、RL 奖励契约或可复现的后训练配方。
why: It is a high-impact Track 12 disclosure boundary: the official report makes some frontier post-training and safety claims auditable while clearly not supplying the data, feedback, lineage, or environment detail needed to reconstruct them.
inclusion_reason: An official frontier system card that discloses broad pretraining sources, filtering, large-scale reasoning RL, deliberative alignment, generated safety data, and safety evaluation procedures while leaving the underlying data, reward, and post-training ledger materially undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html: Closed frontier system cards can state that a reasoning model uses reinforcement learning and safety alignment while withholding the records, feedback contract, and lineage needed to audit or reproduce post-training. This makes a report valuable as a disclosure ledger but insufficient as a reusable reasoning-data recipe.
闭源前沿系统卡可以说明推理模型使用了强化学习和安全对齐，但不公开审计或复现后训练所需的记录、反馈契约和数据谱系。因此，此类报告可作为数据披露账本，却不足以构成可复用的推理数据配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: This Card records the disclosure boundary of the official OpenAI o3-mini System Card. The report identifies broad pretraining-source categories, high-level filtering, large-scale reinforcement learning on reasoning models, deliberative alignment, generated safety data, and multiple safety-evaluation procedures. It does not release a training corpus, record schema, reward/verifier contract, or post-training recipe.
本 Card 记录官方 OpenAI o3-mini System Card 的披露边界。报告说明了宽泛的预训练数据来源类别、高层过滤、大规模推理模型强化学习、deliberative alignment、新生成的安全数据以及多种安全评测流程；但没有发布训练语料、记录模式、奖励或 verifier 契约，也没有给出可复现的后训练配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
Section 2 of the System Card says that o3-mini was pre-trained on a mix of publicly available and custom in-house datasets. It reports quality and risk filtering, reduction of personal information, and use of the Moderation API and safety classifiers to prevent harmful or sensitive content. It also states that o-series reasoning models are trained with large-scale reinforcement learning and can produce a long chain of thought before answering.

The report describes deliberative alignment and says that updating refusal-policy format and generating new safety data formed part of this mitigation work. It distinguishes a near-final checkpoint from the launched checkpoint and says that the latter has small incremental post-training improvements. However, the base-model architecture, sources and quantities of safety data, trace generation, sampling, rollouts, RL objective, reward/verifier, optimizer, schedule, and retained record schema are unknown.

For evaluation rather than documented training, the report uses public and internally constructed tests, autograded refusal metrics, external red teaming, human/expert comparisons, and Preparedness evaluations. The official release also exposes low, medium, and high reasoning-effort options. Evaluation settings include browsing, code execution, prompting, custom training, and scaffolding in some tests; these settings do not disclose the post-training environment.

System Card 第 2 节说明，o3-mini 在公开可得数据与内部自定义数据的混合上进行预训练。报告提到质量与风险过滤、减少个人信息的处理，以及使用 Moderation API 和安全分类器防止有害或敏感内容进入数据；还说明 o 系列推理模型经由大规模强化学习训练，并且可在回答前产生较长的 chain of thought。

报告描述了 deliberative alignment，并说明更新拒绝策略格式和生成新安全数据是这项缓解工作的一部分。它区分了 near-final checkpoint 与发布 checkpoint，并称后者有小幅增量后训练改进。但是，基础模型架构、安全数据的来源与数量、轨迹生成、采样、rollout、RL 目标、奖励或 verifier、优化器、训练日程和保留的记录模式均为 unknown。

报告为评测而非已记录的训练描述了公开及内部构造的测试、自动评分的拒绝指标、外部 red teaming、人类或专家比较和 Preparedness 评测。官方发布页还提供 low、medium、high 三档 reasoning effort。某些评测环境包含浏览、代码执行、提示、定制训练和 scaffolding；这些评测设置并不披露后训练环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official publication page dates the System Card to January 31, 2025 and credits OpenAI. The PDF's Model Data and Training section supports the broad public/in-house pretraining-source statement, filtering claims, and the high-level reinforcement-learning and chain-of-thought claims.

For safety evaluation, the PDF defines not_unsafe and not_overrefuse autograder metrics for refusal tests. It describes external red-team ratings and a Gray Swan jailbreak success criterion requiring both a Moderation API trigger and a classifier assessment of complete/actionable harmful content. In Preparedness evaluation, the report says that capability elicitation can use custom model training, scaffolding, and prompting, and explicitly cautions that reported results are lower bounds that may change with different prompting, fine-tuning, longer rollouts, interactions, or scaffolding.

These are direct disclosures about testing and mitigations. They do not demonstrate that any named autograder, moderation criterion, human rating, or Preparedness task served as the reinforcement-learning training reward.

官方发布页将该 System Card 标为 2025 年 1 月 31 日发布，并署名 OpenAI。PDF 的 Model Data and Training 部分支持关于公开或内部预训练数据类别、过滤以及高层强化学习和 chain-of-thought 的表述。

关于安全评测，PDF 为拒绝测试定义了 not_unsafe 和 not_overrefuse 自动评分指标；它描述了外部 red team 评分，以及 Gray Swan 的 jailbreak 成功条件：同时触发 Moderation API 并通过判断内容是否含有完整、可操作有害步骤的分类器。在 Preparedness 评测中，报告说明能力诱发可使用定制模型训练、scaffolding 和提示，并明确警示所报告结果只是下界，可能因不同提示、微调、更长 rollout、交互或 scaffolding 而改变。

这些内容是关于测试和缓解措施的直接披露，并不能证明任何已命名的自动评分器、审核标准、人类评分或 Preparedness 任务被用作强化学习训练奖励。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For this atlas, the useful contribution is not a released data artifact or a fully specified learning method. The System Card provides a source-backed boundary between disclosed category-level ingredients—data classes, filtering, reasoning RL, deliberative alignment, safety-data generation, and evaluations—and undisclosed record-level data and feedback mechanics. That distinction prevents a closed-model safety report from being mistaken for an open reasoning-data recipe.
就本 atlas 而言，其有用贡献不是一个已发布的数据工件，也不是完整规定的学习方法。System Card 提供了有来源支持的边界：数据类别、过滤、推理 RL、deliberative alignment、安全数据生成和评测等仅在类别层面被披露，而记录级数据和反馈机制未披露。这一区分可避免把闭源模型安全报告误解为开放的推理数据配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The source mixture lacks identities, proportions, counts, acquisition terms, rights, manifests, and item-level lineage. The report does not disclose train/evaluation splits, decontamination or benchmark-overlap controls, data licenses, a training-record schema, chain-of-thought retention policy, or source-to-checkpoint traceability.

The reinforcement-learning objective, reward/verifier, safety-data provenance and labels, teacher/generator, sampling, rollout count, optimizer, schedule, compute, and training environment are unknown. Evaluation autograders and red-team judgments should not be promoted to training feedback without evidence. Production measurements can vary with system updates, final parameters, and system-level instructions, while the report itself treats Preparedness evaluations as lower bounds.

数据混合缺少来源身份、比例、数量、获取条款、权利、清单和条目级谱系。报告未披露训练或评测切分、去污染或基准重叠控制、数据许可证、训练记录模式、chain-of-thought 保留策略或从来源到 checkpoint 的可追溯性。

强化学习目标、奖励或 verifier、安全数据的来源与标签、教师或生成器、采样、rollout 数、优化器、训练日程、计算量和训练环境均为 unknown。没有证据时，不应将评测自动评分器或 red-team 判断升级为训练反馈。生产测量可随系统更新、最终参数和 系统级指令 改变，且报告本身将 Preparedness 评测视为下界。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to audit what a closed frontier reasoning report actually reveals about post-training. It is useful for separating safety-evaluation feedback from a training reward, recording the disclosed filtering and alignment claims, and converting missing data, lineage, and reproducibility details into explicit follow-up requests.

It supports safety-alignment and evaluation analysis, not direct reuse of a dataset, verifier, RLVR objective, or agent-training environment. Comparisons with open releases should preserve that asymmetry: the report is evidence of a disclosure boundary, not evidence that the underlying recipe is available or independently reproducible.

可使用本 Card 审计一份闭源前沿推理报告实际上披露了哪些后训练信息。它有助于区分安全评测反馈与训练奖励，记录已披露的过滤和对齐主张，并把缺失的数据、谱系和可复现性细节转化为明确的后续索取项。

它支持安全对齐和评测分析，而不支持直接复用数据集、verifier、RLVR 目标或 agent 训练环境。与开放发布进行比较时应保持这种不对称性：该报告是数据披露边界的证据，而不是底层配方可获得或可独立复现的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 2 as a category-level disclosure, not as a source manifest or released corpus.
  • Keep the reported evaluation autograders, human ratings, and moderation criteria separate from the undisclosed RL reward/verifier.
  • Track the difference between the near-final and launched checkpoints; only small incremental post-training improvements are disclosed.
  • Treat Preparedness results as bounded evaluation evidence, since the report states that elicitation and production conditions can change observed performance.

• 将第 2 节理解为类别级披露，而不是来源清单或已发布语料。
  • 将已报告的评测自动评分器、人类评分和审核标准与未披露的 RL 奖励或 verifier 分开处理。
  • 注意 near-final 与发布 checkpoint 的差异；报告只披露了小幅增量后训练改进。
  • 将 Preparedness 结果视为有边界的评测证据，因为报告说明能力诱发和生产条件会改变观测性能。
